verdict.rationale: PayPal publishes an official MCP server in two forms. One runs locally via npx @paypal/mcp. The other is remotely hosted, with documented sandbox and production endpoints, SSE and Streamable HTTP transports, and token auth. It is backed by a documented tool inventory and LLM quickstarts. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: PayPal built an MCP server that lets merchants use natural language with their favorite MCP clients.
PayPal ships BOTH deployment modes of its MCP server: local via `npx -y @paypal/mcp --tools=all`
PayPal's remote MCP server now supports large language models (LLMs) from Anthropic and OpenAI
